name: sequence_id
meaning: The read's id: the input record's id (a repeated id gets a _dupN suffix), or the --id-column value of a table.

name: sequence
meaning: The read as aligned (cut to its first 575 nt when longer); for a reverse-complement read, the original read (see rev_comp).

name: rev_comp
meaning: T when the read was reverse-complemented to align: coordinates and alignments then refer to the reverse complement of sequence.

name: locus
meaning: The locus of the V call (IGH, IGK, IGL, TRA, TRB, TRD or TRG); a model of one locus writes it for every read.

name: v_call
meaning: The V allele call; alleles that match the read equally well follow it, comma-separated (IgBLAST's convention).

name: d_call
meaning: The D allele call: one allele (only v_call lists tied alleles).

name: j_call
meaning: The J allele call: one allele (only v_call lists tied alleles).

name: c_call
meaning: The constant-region gene. AlignAIR does not call it; a --metadata table may fill it (10x c_gene).

name: productive
meaning: T when the rearrangement is productive: V and J in frame, no stop codon, conserved junction anchors.

name: productive_prediction
meaning: The same call as productive, kept for tools that read this column.

name: vj_in_frame
meaning: T when V and J are in the same reading frame.

name: stop_codon
meaning: T when the aligned sequence holds a stop codon in the V reading frame.

name: v_identity
meaning: The fraction of the aligned V bases that match the germline.

name: d_identity
meaning: The fraction of the aligned D bases that match the germline.

name: j_identity
meaning: The fraction of the aligned J bases that match the germline.

name: sequence_alignment
meaning: The aligned read, IMGT-gapped (dots in the V gaps).

name: germline_alignment
meaning: The germline the read aligns to, IMGT-gapped, position for position with sequence_alignment (N in the junction's untemplated bases).

name: sequence_alignment_aa
meaning: sequence_alignment translated.

name: germline_alignment_aa
meaning: germline_alignment translated.

name: junction
meaning: The junction: CDR3 with its conserved anchors (V's Cys to J's Trp or Phe).

name: junction_aa
meaning: The junction translated (X for an incomplete codon).

name: junction_length
meaning: The junction's length in nucleotides.

name: junction_aa_length
meaning: The junction's length in amino acids.

name: np1
meaning: The untemplated bases between V and D (between V and J without a D).

name: np1_length
meaning: The length of np1.

name: np2
meaning: The untemplated bases between D and J.

name: np2_length
meaning: The length of np2.

name: v_cigar
meaning: The V alignment of the read against its germline, as a CIGAR string.

name: d_cigar
meaning: The D alignment of the read against its germline, as a CIGAR string.

name: j_cigar
meaning: The J alignment of the read against its germline, as a CIGAR string.

name: v_sequence_start
meaning: Where V starts in sequence.

name: v_sequence_end
meaning: Where V ends in sequence.

name: v_germline_start
meaning: Where the alignment starts in the V germline.

name: v_germline_end
meaning: Where the alignment ends in the V germline.

name: d_sequence_start
meaning: Where D starts in sequence.

name: d_sequence_end
meaning: Where D ends in sequence.

name: d_germline_start
meaning: Where the alignment starts in the D germline.

name: d_germline_end
meaning: Where the alignment ends in the D germline.

name: j_sequence_start
meaning: Where J starts in sequence.

name: j_sequence_end
meaning: Where J ends in sequence.

name: j_germline_start
meaning: Where the alignment starts in the J germline.

name: j_germline_end
meaning: Where the alignment ends in the J germline.

name: fwr1
meaning: The read's framework region 1.

name: fwr1_aa
meaning: The framework region 1 translated.

name: fwr1_start
meaning: Where the framework region 1 starts in sequence.

name: fwr1_end
meaning: Where the framework region 1 ends in sequence.

name: cdr1
meaning: The read's CDR1.

name: cdr1_aa
meaning: The CDR1 translated.

name: cdr1_start
meaning: Where the CDR1 starts in sequence.

name: cdr1_end
meaning: Where the CDR1 ends in sequence.

name: fwr2
meaning: The read's framework region 2.

name: fwr2_aa
meaning: The framework region 2 translated.

name: fwr2_start
meaning: Where the framework region 2 starts in sequence.

name: fwr2_end
meaning: Where the framework region 2 ends in sequence.

name: cdr2
meaning: The read's CDR2.

name: cdr2_aa
meaning: The CDR2 translated.

name: cdr2_start
meaning: Where the CDR2 starts in sequence.

name: cdr2_end
meaning: Where the CDR2 ends in sequence.

name: fwr3
meaning: The read's framework region 3.

name: fwr3_aa
meaning: The framework region 3 translated.

name: fwr3_start
meaning: Where the framework region 3 starts in sequence.

name: fwr3_end
meaning: Where the framework region 3 ends in sequence.

name: cdr3
meaning: The read's CDR3.

name: cdr3_aa
meaning: The CDR3 translated.

name: cdr3_start
meaning: Where the CDR3 starts in sequence.

name: cdr3_end
meaning: Where the CDR3 ends in sequence.

name: fwr4
meaning: The read's framework region 4.

name: fwr4_aa
meaning: The framework region 4 translated.

name: fwr4_start
meaning: Where the framework region 4 starts in sequence.

name: fwr4_end
meaning: Where the framework region 4 ends in sequence.

name: v_sequence_alignment
meaning: The read's V part of sequence_alignment.

name: v_germline_alignment
meaning: The V germline's part of germline_alignment.

name: v_sequence_alignment_aa
meaning: v_sequence_alignment translated.

name: v_germline_alignment_aa
meaning: v_germline_alignment translated.

name: v_alignment_start
meaning: Where V starts in sequence_alignment.

name: v_alignment_end
meaning: Where V ends in sequence_alignment.

name: d_sequence_alignment
meaning: The read's D part of sequence_alignment.

name: d_germline_alignment
meaning: The D germline's part of germline_alignment.

name: d_sequence_alignment_aa
meaning: d_sequence_alignment translated.

name: d_germline_alignment_aa
meaning: d_germline_alignment translated.

name: d_alignment_start
meaning: Where D starts in sequence_alignment.

name: d_alignment_end
meaning: Where D ends in sequence_alignment.

name: j_sequence_alignment
meaning: The read's J part of sequence_alignment.

name: j_germline_alignment
meaning: The J germline's part of germline_alignment.

name: j_sequence_alignment_aa
meaning: j_sequence_alignment translated.

name: j_germline_alignment_aa
meaning: j_germline_alignment translated.

name: j_alignment_start
meaning: Where J starts in sequence_alignment.

name: j_alignment_end
meaning: Where J ends in sequence_alignment.

name: v_call_set
meaning: The candidate set: the V alleles the model scored as possible before the germline refinement, comma-separated (the v_call can fall outside it).

name: d_call_set
meaning: The candidate set: the D alleles the model scored as possible before the germline refinement, comma-separated (the d_call can fall outside it).

name: j_call_set
meaning: The candidate set: the J alleles the model scored as possible before the germline refinement, comma-separated (the j_call can fall outside it).

name: mutation_rate
meaning: AlignAIR's estimate of the read's somatic mutation rate over its V, D and J.

name: orientation
meaning: How the read was turned to align: forward, reverse_complement, complement or reverse.

name: input_sequence
meaning: The read as given, before orientation.

name: segmentation_low_quality
meaning: T when the read's V or J segment came out empty or reversed: treat its calls with caution.

name: length_cropped
meaning: T when the read was longer than 575 nt and only its first 575 nt were aligned.

name: airr_assembly_status
meaning: complete (every field derived), partial (valid calls, some fields left blank: see airr_assembly_reason) or failed (see airr_assembly_error).

name: airr_assembly_reason
meaning: Why a partial row is partial (e.g. no_v: the read has no V call).

name: airr_assembly_error
meaning: The error that stopped a failed row's assembly.
